'''Greater demon berserkers''' are monsters released with [[The Zamorakian Undercity]]. These demons are immune to stun and poison, whereas their [[Greater demon berserker|Wilderness counterparts]] have less health and are susceptible to both stun and poison.

These monsters are capable of pathing around obstacles to reach the player and can deal immense amounts of damage with their melee attacks. They may be killed for a [[Demons (Slayer assignment)|demon]] or [[Greater demons (Slayer assignment)|greater demon task]] for more slayer experience. 

Although they attack with a fireball animation, they only deal melee damage. However, they are much stronger than most other demons. They should not be confused for the nearby and similar-looking [[Greater demon ash lord (The Zamorakian Undercity)|ash lords]]; the berserker's horns are pointed downwards, while the ash lord's is pointed upwards.

==Trivia==
* This type of greater demon used to possess the [[Strong guard (status)|Strong guard]] status, which made the players' attacks incapable of missing and made their [[Ability damage|damage]] dependent on their [[Hit chance|accuracy]]; this was effectively replaced by the damage potential system on [[4 March]] [[2024]].
